title: TVÅMASTAD LED portable lamp
description: TVÅMASTAD LED portable lamp, battery operated brass/opal glass This stylish little LED lamp with a brass-colored base is battery-operated and easy to move from room to room. The frosted glass of the shade spreads a soft light that feels homely and inviting.
features: Rechargeable batteries are sold separately.The charging function of this product only works with rechargeable batteries. recommends LADDA 2450 mAh HR06 AA 1.2V. 4 pcs are required.
USB-C cable and USB power adapter are sold separately.
Built-in LED light source that lasts approx. 25,000 hours.
When fully charged, the product will give full light for approx. 20 hours.
Only use batteries that are intended for the product. Do not mix old and new batteries, different brands or types.
Batteries should be handed in for recycling in accordance with local environmental regulations for waste disposal.
This product also illuminates without batteries, if you connect a USB-C cable.
Observe the polarity marks plus (+) and minus (−) and ensure correct battery insertion into the product.
materialAndCare: Shade: Glass, Paint; Tube/ Handle/ Base/ Decoration: Steel, Nickel plated, Acrylic coating
